:::{#rem-matrix-analysis}
#### Linear algebra and matrix analysis

*Matrix analysis* is the study of matrices and their algebraic properties,
with operations on matrices, functions of matrices and the eigenvalues of matrices as example topics
[@wikipedia_matrix_analysis].
It is usually placed within linear algebra and its applications
[@wikipedia_matrix_analysis],
and these notes do not treat it as a separate subject:
they use the name *linear algebra* for all of the matrix material in the pages that follow.
@banerjee2014linear pairs the two names in its title.
Its preface says that its last chapters cover convergence of matrices and Hilbert spaces
[@banerjee2014linear, p. xvi].

:::
